arxiv-2101-12711.title: The isoperimetric problem on Riemannian manifolds via Gromov–Hausdorff asymptotic analysis
arxiv-2101-12711.creator: Gioacchino Antonelli, Mattia Fogagnolo, Marco Pozzetta
arxiv-2101-12711.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gioacchino Antonelli, Mattia Fogagnolo, Marco Pozzetta. In this paper we prove the existence of isoperimetric regions of any volume in Riemannian manifolds with Ricci bounded below assuming Gromov–Hausdorff asymptoticity to the suitable simply connected model of constant sectional curvature. The previous result is a consequence of a general structure theorem for perimeter-minimizing sequences of sets of fixed volume on noncollapsed Riemannian manifolds with a lower bound on the Ricci curvature.

arxiv-2210-06449.title: To the kinetic theory of dense gases and liquids. Calculation of quasi-equilibrium particle distribution functions by the method of collective variables
arxiv-2210-06449.creator: Tokarchuk M
arxiv-2210-06449.description: Abstract Based on a chain of BBGKI equations with a modified boundary condition that takes into account multiparticle correlations, kinetic equations in the approximate “pairs” collisions and in the polarization approximation, taking into account the interaction through the third particle, obtained.

arxiv-2303-14450.title: AdS Black Hole with Cylindrical Symmetry
arxiv-2303-14450.creator: Mehdi Sadeghi, Ramin Anvari Asl, Mohammad Shamseh
arxiv-2303-14450.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider Einstein-Hilbert gravity in the presence of cosmological constant with cylindrical symmetry to introduce the black hole solution of this model. Here, we solve the Einstein’s vacuum field equation, and then we calculate the appropriate metric for this problem.

arxiv-2311-04061.title: Neural Appearance Model for Cloth Rendering Volume: 43 Issue: 4
arxiv-2311-04061.creator: G. Y. Soh and Z. Montazeri University of Manchester, United Kingdom
arxiv-2311-04061.description: Abstract The realistic rendering of woven and knitted fabrics has posed significant challenges throughout many years. Previously, fiber-based micro-appearance models have achieved considerable success in attaining high levels of realism. However, rendering such models remains complex due to the intricate internal scatterings of hundreds of fibers within a yarn, requiring vast amounts of memory and time to render.

arxiv-2404-09881.title: Charmonium Transport in Heavy-Ion Collisions at the LHC
arxiv-2404-09881.creator: Biaogang Wu, Ralf Rapp
arxiv-2404-09881.description: Abstract We provide an update on our semi-classical transport approach for quarkonium production in high-energy heavy-ion collisions, focusing on J / ψ J/\psi and ψ ⁡ ( 2 ​ S ) \psi(2S) mesons in 5.02 TeV Pb-Pb collisions at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at both forward and mid-rapidity.

arxiv-2408-01399.title: Cluster production and the chemical freeze-out in expanding hot dense matter
arxiv-2408-01399.creator: D. Blaschke, S. Liebing, G. Röpke, B. Dönigus
arxiv-2408-01399.description: Abstract We discuss medium effects on light cluster production in the QCD phase diagram by relating Mott transition lines to those for chemical freeze-out. In heavy-ion collisions at highest energies provided by the LHC, light cluster abundances should follow the statistical model because of low baryon densities. Chemical freeze-out in this domain is correlated with the QCD crossover transition.

arxiv-2408-16816.title: Minimal targets for dilaton direct detection
arxiv-2408-16816.creator: David Cyncynates, Olivier Simon
arxiv-2408-16816.description: Abstract Fifth force and equivalence principle tests search for new interactions by precisely measuring forces between macroscopic collections of atoms and molecules and their properties under free fall. In contrast, the early Universe plasma probes these interactions at a more fundamental level.

arxiv-2412-04021.title: Restoring Missing Modes of 21cm Intensity Mapping with Deep Learning: Impact on BAO Reconstruction
arxiv-2412-04021.creator: Xiaolin Luo
arxiv-2412-04021.description: Abstract In 21cm intensity mapping of the large-scale structure (LSS), regions in Fourier space could be compromised by foreground contamination. In interferometric observations, this contamination, known as the foreground wedge, is exacerbated by the chromatic response of antennas, leading to substantial data loss.

arxiv-2506-01279.title: W W -entropy formulas and Langevin deformation on the L q L^{q} -Wasserstein space over Riemannian manifolds
arxiv-2506-01279.creator: Rong Lei, Xiang-Dong Li, Yu-Zhao Wang
arxiv-2506-01279.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rong Lei, Xiang-Dong Li, Yu-Zhao Wang. We first prove the W W -entropy formula and rigidity theorem for the geodesic flow on the L q L^{q} -Wasserstein space over a complete Riemannian manifold with bounded geometry condition.

arxiv-2507-01379.title: Structure of Kerr black hole spacetimes in Weyl conformal gravity Journal: Class. Quantum Grav.
arxiv-2507-01379.creator: Miguel Yulo Asuncion, Keith Horne, Reinosuke Kusano, Martin Dominik
arxiv-2507-01379.description: Abstract We analyze the stationary, uncharged, rotating, vacuum solution to Weyl conformal gravity. We elucidate the causal and ergoregion structure of the spacetimes found in the parameter space of the metric for positive mass. These are then compared to the corollary Kerr, Kerr-de Sitter, and Kerr-Anti-de Sitter solutions to general relativity.

arxiv-2509-01647.title: Onset of CN Emission in 3I/ATLAS: Evidence for Strong Carbon-Chain Depletion Facilities: MDM: Hiltner 2.4 m and McGraw-Hill 1.3 m astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 )
arxiv-2509-01647.creator: Luis E. Salazar Manzano, Hsing Wen Lin(林省文), Aster G. Taylor, Darryl Z. Seligman, Fred C. Adams, David W. Gerdes, Thomas Ruch, Tessa T. Frincke, Kevin J. Napier
arxiv-2509-01647.description: Abstract Interstellar objects provide a direct window into the environmental conditions around stars other than the Sun. The recent discovery of 3I/ATLAS, the second interstellar comet ever observed, offers a unique opportunity to investigate the physical and chemical properties of interstellar objects and to compare them with those of comets in our own Solar System.

arxiv-2511-05437.title: Point Defects Limited Carrier Mobility in Janus MoSSe monolayer
arxiv-2511-05437.creator: Nguyen Tran Gia Bao, Ton Nu Quynh Trang, Phan Bach Thang, Nam Thoai, Vu Thi Hanh Thu, Nguyen Tuan Hung
arxiv-2511-05437.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nguyen Tran Gia Bao, Ton Nu Quynh Trang, Phan Bach Thang, Nam Thoai, Vu Thi Hanh Thu, Nguyen Tuan Hung. Point defects, often formed during the growth of Janus MoSSe, act as built-in scatterers and affect carrier transport in electronic devices based on Janus MoSSe. In this study, we employ first-principles calculations to investigate the impact of common defects, such as sulfur vacancies, selenium vacancies, and chalcogen substitutions, on electron transport, and compare their influence with that of mobility limited by phonons.

arxiv-2512-15848.title: Quadrupolar and dipolar phases of excitons in transition-metal dichalcogenide trilayer heterostructures
arxiv-2512-15848.creator: Michal Zimmerman, Daniel Podolsky, Ronen Rapaport, Snir Gazit
arxiv-2512-15848.description: Abstract Recent experiments on trilayer transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures have revealed the rich behavior of dipolar excitons. Motivated by these experimental observations, we investigate the collective dynamics of planar quantum dipoles whose orientation fluctuates due to charge tunneling between the outer layers.

arxiv-2602-07447.title: Measuring cross-language intelligibility between Romance languages with computational tools
arxiv-2602-07447.creator: Liviu P Dinu Ana Sabina Uban Bogdan Iordache, Anca Dinu Simona Georgescu, University of Bucharest, Faculty of Mathematics, Computer Science
arxiv-2602-07447.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Liviu P Dinu Ana Sabina Uban Bogdan Iordache, Anca Dinu Simona Georgescu, University of Bucharest, Faculty of Mathematics, Computer Science. We present an analysis of mutual intelligibility in related languages applied for languages in the Romance family.

pmc-12613561.title: Analysis of the association of neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, MPV-to-platelet ratio, and clinical risk factors for mortality in ICU patients with candidemia: a 10-year retrospective analysis
pmc-12613561.creator: İlker Ödemiş, Eren Arkalı, Süheyla Serin Senger, Duygu Tekin, Gürsel Ersan, Sabri Atalay, Merve Nur Filiz
pmc-12613561.description: BackgroundCandidaemia is a leading cause of mortality in hospitalized patients. The determination of risk factors is necessary to predict mortality. We aimed to evaluate whether the neutrophil, lymphocyte, monocyte, and platelet counts; red blood cell distribution width (RDW), mean platelet volume (MPV), neutrophil/lymphocyte (N/L) and MPV/platelet count (MPV/plt) ratios, and other clinical characteristics are risk factors for mortality.

pmc-13054109.title: The Analgesic Effect of Extended Reality (XR) on Acute and Postoperative Pain in Children: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13054109.creator: Louise Meulenkamp‐Yilmaz, Souraya El Bardai, Manon H J Hillegers, Jeroen Legerstee, Bram Dierckx, Lonneke Staals
pmc-13054109.description: BackgroundAcute and postoperative pain in children is often undertreated, with effects on patient comfort and postoperative recovery. Extended reality (XR) interventions offer non‐pharmacological pain management by distracting patients from discomfort. While effective for procedural pain, its impact on prolonged pain episodes remains underexplored.

pmc-13070433.title: The Price of a Whipple: Predicting Hospital Charges Using Preoperative Patient Characteristics
pmc-13070433.creator: Sri Snehita Reddy Bonthu, Sourodip Mukharjee, Joshua Kong, Juan Malo, Houssam Osman, D. Rohan Jeyarajah
pmc-13070433.description: BackgroundWhipple's pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD) is a highly complex hepato‐pancreato‐biliary (HPB) procedure associated with substantial morbidity and cost. Although postoperative complications are known to increase healthcare expenditures, few studies have explored the association between preoperative factors and healthcare costs. This study evaluated the predictive value of baseline patient characteristics and preoperative laboratory tests in estimating index admission charges for Whipple's PD.

pmc-13108374.title: Response to Commentary on Repeatability of Multiple Breath Washout in Pediatric Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia
pmc-13108374.creator: Wallace Wee, Sharon Dell
pmc-13108374.description: We agree that the standardization of airway clearance is important and has the potential to influence the lung clearance index (LCI). Our study had two arms (a) same‐day repeat testing, and (b) 28‐day repeat testing. For the same‐day repeat testing, we ensured that no pulmonary interventions were completed between repeat testing, thus eliminating airway clearance as a potential confounder.

pmc-13135194.title: Influence of MC1R Gene Variants on Coat Color of Indicine Cattle Breeds
pmc-13135194.creator: Silel V S A Maciel, Ingrid P P Oliveira, Beatriz B Senes, Carolaine J S Santana, Jackeline S Alves, Edilane A da Silva, Fernando O Franco, Bárbara C F da Silva, Fernando C Cairo, Frederico C Cairo, Aníbal E Vercesi‐Filho, Raphael B Costa, Gregório M F de Camargo
pmc-13135194.description: Indicine cattle display a broad range of coat colors, representing a relevant and breed‐defining trait required for registration in breeder association. Among the genes involved in pigmentation, MC1R stands out for modulating the synthesis of melanin‐related proteins and remains poorly explored in indicine cattle breeds.

pmc-13270512.title: Assessing Black Carbon and Iron Oxide Aerosols: A Comparative Study between Urban and Rural Environments in the Southeastern U.S.
pmc-13270512.creator: Shreya Suri, Lifei Yin, Bin Bai, Yuhan Yang, Dongli Wang, Andrew R. Metcalf, Nathan Chellman, Robert F. Swarthout, James Sherman, Pengfei Liu
pmc-13270512.description: Black carbon (BC) and iron oxide (FeO x ) aerosols represent important contributors to shortwave atmospheric heating and have been associated with adverse human health outcomes. Accurate measurement of BC and FeO x is crucial for understanding their roles in climate forcing and air quality. However, observational dataparticularly for anthropogenic FeO x remain limited.

pmc-13412679.title: Evolutionary Predictors of Post-COVID Syndrome
pmc-13412679.creator: Maria Luisa Asensio Tomás, Philip Erick Wikman-Jorgensen, Jose Antonio Quesada-Rico, José Miguel Seguí-Ripoll, Vicente Gil-Guillén, Vicente Giner-Galvañ
pmc-13412679.description: Objectives: To analyze evolutionary predictors of post-COVID syndrome (PCS). Methods: This Cohort study was conducted from April 2021 to December 2023. PCS persistence was defined as a score of ≥2 points on the post-COVID-19 Functional Status (PCFS) scale (range 0–4, where higher scores indicate more limitations). Symptom clusters were identified using correspondence analysis.

pmc-13449323.title: MolMeDB RDF: transforming a relational database about biological membranes to the RDF format to increase interoperability
pmc-13449323.creator: Dominik Martinát, Jakub Juračka, Jakub Galgonek, Karel Berka
pmc-13449323.description: Data on molecular behaviour within biological membrane models are pivotal for predictive pharmacology, particularly for modelling bioavailability and target engagement. MolMeDB provides a curated collection of such compound-membrane interaction data. To facilitate automated reasoning and data federation, we present a semantic transformation of MolMeDB into Resource Description Framework (RDF) format, exposed through a public SPARQL endpoint.
